mapper.select: SELECT NVL(SUM(patient_count), 0) AS patientCount, -- 患者人数 NVL(SUM(treatment_count), 0) AS treatmentCount, -- 治疗人次 NVL(SUM(treatment_amount), 0) AS treatmentAmount, -- 治疗金额 ROUND(NVL(SUM(treatment_amount), 0) / NULLIF(SUM(treatment_count), 0), 2) AS avgAmount -- 平均金额 FROM TR_TREAT_STAT_OV WHERE stat_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}

SELECT trend_date AS trendDate, -- 趋势日期 NVL(SUM(trend_value), 0) AS trendValue -- 趋势值 FROM TR_TREAT_STAT_TREND WHERE stat_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY trend_date ORDER BY trend_date

SELECT item_name AS "name", -- 治疗项目名称 NVL(SUM(treatment_count), 0) AS "value" -- 治疗人次 FROM TR_TREAT_STAT_ITEM WHERE stat_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY item_name ORDER BY NVL(SUM(treatment_count), 0) DESC
